subject: Debit note for INV-2526-01288
body:
Dear Nova Systems Pvt Ltd team,

We have reviewed invoice INV-2526-01288 dated 9 Sep 2025 and found that HSN 998314 (IT & Software Services) was taxed at 5 percent instead of the applicable 18 percent. This resulted in a short tax of Rs 25,000.

We will raise a debit note for Rs 25,000 and send a corrected invoice. Please adjust your records accordingly.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
